slide1.subtitle: QUICK INVOICING
slide1.title: Billing Page
slide1.description: Search and add medications directly from inventory, add new medicines on the fly, and review complete invoices before saving.
slide1.bullet1_text: Search and add medications directly from your existing inventory.
slide1.bullet2_text: Add completely new medicines to mobile right from the billing screen.
slide1.bullet3_text: Review the complete invoice and modify stored items before saving the final bill.

slide2.subtitle: STOCK MANAGEMENT
slide2.title: Stock Page
slide2.description: Supports storage and management of up to 2.5L+ medicine records with instant stock updates and flexible management.
slide2.bullet1_text: Supports storage and management of up to 2.5L+ medicine records.
slide2.bullet2_text: Add new stock or update existing quantities instantly.
slide2.bullet3_text: Modify stored medicine details anytime to maintain accurate records.

slide3.subtitle: BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE
slide3.title: Analytics Page
slide3.description: Tracks precise, time-stamped purchase and sales histories with comprehensive drug details and simplified compliance.
slide3.bullet1_text: Tracks precise, time-stamped purchase and sales histories.
slide3.bullet2_text: Captures drug name, batch number, expiry date, price, and supplier/buyer details.
slide3.bullet3_text: Streamlines data maintenance to make updating official medical registers effortless.

slide4.subtitle: LOCAL FIRST & SECURE
slide4.title: Settings Page
slide4.description: Securely manages your data locally without requiring external internet connectivity, ensuring complete privacy.
slide4.bullet1_text: Securely manages your data locally without requiring any external internet connectivity.
slide4.bullet2_text: Enhances data security through a self-contained local storage structure with a complete privacy guarantee.
slide4.bullet3_text: Modifies shop information, details, and print headers effortlessly.
slide4.bullet4_text: Changes the system language dynamically to suit your operational needs.
slide4.bullet5_text: Utilises a secure bill reset option to permanently wipe all billing records instantly.
